identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase1/phase2，Single-arm, Open-label Study of RD14-01 in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This single-arm, open-label, dose-escalation and dose-expansion study will evaluate the safety and tolerability of RD14-01, ROR1-targeting CAR T cells, in adults with ROR1+ advanced solid tumors.

primaryOutcomes.description: Dose-limiting toxicity (DLT) and maximum tolerated dose (MTD)
Adverse events (TEAEs) and incidence after the first infusion, treatment-related adverse events and incidence, adverse events of special concern (AESI) and incidence

secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall Response Rate (ORR) by RECIST, version 1.1

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Maximum concentration of RD14-01 (Cmax) in peripheral blood (PB) samples
secondaryOutcomes.description: Maximum concentration of RD14-01 (Cmax) in peripheral blood (PB) samples

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Persistence of RD14-01 CAR T cells in peripheral blood samples
